# Strike — inspiration only

Sports clubs. Motion personality: kinetic editorial. Split-flap, marquee, masked type. No springs, no blobs, no bounce.

## Look at

- Mat Voyce, Uncommon Studio. Awwwards SOTD and FWA. Per-character transforms, one ease. https://www.hontran.dev/blog/mat-voyce-case-study-award-winning-portfolio
- Codrops, On-Scroll Text Motion, December 2025. Typographic scroll, not a card fade. https://tympanus.net/Development/ScrollTextMotion/
- Motion.dev text animation. Split, clip, scramble, count. We write our own. https://motion.dev/docs/text-animation
- Design Lounge split-flap brief. `rotateX` flaps, reduced motion shows the final glyph. https://www.designlounge.live/p/split-flap-board
- Envato, 30 March 2026. Kinetic type and type-as-layout. https://elements.envato.com/learn/web-design-trends

## We will write

Night paper and electric crimson. A score that flips. A fixture marquee. Headlines that rise inside a clip. Sharp ease, no overshoot.

## We will not write

Their GSAP setup, a navy sports broadcast, or beige newsprint.
